newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - November 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - November 27.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Wednesday. Reuter has not verified the stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Investigators put the focus of the shooting at Taoyuan magistrate's home, which killed eight people, on disagreements among local political fractions.
Senior students at Kuo Kuang art school beat up junior students in school.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Authorities begin investigating a local business group in connection with the shooting at Taoyuan magiatrate's home.
Investigators say they are counting the days to solving the shooting case.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Taiwan's provincial government borrows T$200 billion from state banks to meet its financial obligations.
The labour insurance law may apply to the banking industry soon.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Some T$160 billion of funds flooded into the stock market recently.
The Mainland Affairs Council plans to issue a statement on Taiwan-China economic ties at the end of 1996.
